description: Return a link that opens the AkulaCyber store cart with the chosen products and quantities already in it, with current prices in UAH. The buyer opens the link, checks the cart and places the order on the site (delivery and payment are chosen at checkout); nothing is ordered or reserved by this tool. Products out of stock are left out of the link and listed in unavailable.

items.description: One to ten products for the cart.

product.description: Product slug (gl-rm1), model or part number, or GTIN.

lang.description: Language of the answer: uk (Ukrainian), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language of the user.

name: akulacyber_cart_link
title: Make an AkulaCyber cart link
